Shooting a gun looks simple enough. Just aim and pull the trigger, right? Well, there's a lot more to it! From ridiculous shooting techniques to dangerous mistakes that could end in disaster, even the smallest error can have serious consequences. Here are some of the worst ways to handle a firearm!
